variants.name: Original 35 g
variants.about_this_item: Beaphar Malt Bits are delicious, healthy treats, and an ideal hairball remedy for cats. The bits are small and cushion-shaped with a crunchy exterior that most cats love. Each treat is filled with tasty malt hairball paste to help ensure the smooth, natural passage of ingested hair through your cat’s intestines. Beaphar Malt Bits contain natural ingredients which may lead to small colour variations, and are packed in re-sealable pouches to keep the bits fresh and tasty for your cat. Great to give as a reward each day or as a tasty daily treat. Suitable for cats of all ages and breeds.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: Cereals, Milk and milk derivatives, Oils and fats, Derivatives of vegetable origin (Malt extract 1,7%), Minerals, Yeasts, Fish and fish derivatives, Meat and animal derivatives Analytical constituents
variants.feeding_instructions: ALWAYS FULLY READ THE PRODUCT PACKAGING BEFORE USE. Give 5–10 Beaphar Malt Bits per day as a treat or reward. Always have fresh drinking water available.

variants.name: Salmon 35 g
variants.about_this_item: Salmon Bits is a healthy and crunchy cat snack for in between. Not just any treat, but filled with tasty salmon-flavoured Malt hairball pasta. This paste promotes natural drainage of ingested hair. This product is made from natural ingredients, which may cause color variations.
variants.ingredient_information: Composition: Cereals, Milk and milk derivatives, Oils and fats, Derivatives of vegetable origin, Minerals, Yeasts, Fish and fish derivatives, Meat and meat derivatives
